title: "Hi, I Already Love You"
old_caption:
Ever wanted to say "I love you" in the first message?
Big heart, small first step. Start with something kind.

title: Hi [NAME]!
old_caption:
Sent the copy-paste opener with the brackets still in?
Write it for them, using something from their profile.

title: Correcting Their Bio
old_caption:
Correcting their grammar as a first message?
Lead with what you liked about their bio instead.

title: All About Me
old_caption:
Opened with a list of your best qualities?
Make the first question about them.

title: "What's Your Deepest Fear?"
old_caption:
"What's your deepest fear?" on day one?
Go deep later. Start with something small and easy to answer.

title: The Job Interview Opener
old_caption:
Does your first message sound like a job interview?
It's a chat. Ask something fun, like the best thing they ate.

title: Meet My Family (Opener)
old_caption:
Inviting a new match to the family holidays already?
Save the big plans. A cosy little question is enough for now.

title: The Multiple-Choice Hello
old_caption:
Can't pick between hi, hey and hello?
Pick one and press send, then ask about their weekend.

title: The Space Fact Opener
old_caption:
Is a space fact a good opener?
Share your nerdy thing, then ask for theirs.

title: Three Days Late
old_caption:
Replied three days late with "sorry was busy"?
Late is fine. An honest line about why lands much better.
